visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A high-angle static close-up focuses on a large white IKEA price tag hanging from the ceiling by thin wires. The tag features black text 'METOD/VEDDINGE', 'High cabinet', and a large price '$10,970'. A blue IKEA logo is visible at the bottom right. Large, bold white-bordered blue text '在 IKEA 會搞錯的事情' is overlaid in the center of the frame. (2) The scene cuts to a medium shot of a person with short grey hair, wearing a black hoodie under a white fleece vest and a white crossbody bag. They walk away from the camera through a well-lit IKEA showroom filled with wooden tables, chairs, and shelves. They are holding a blue drink cup in their right hand. (3) The character stops beside two large silver cylindrical trash cans placed near a white pillar. One has a green 'Recyclable' label and the other a black 'General Waste' label. As they approach, the visual shifts to black-and-white with white mathematical equations (formulas, graphs) floating over the frame to indicate confusion. The character looks at the camera with a startled expression, then bends down to peer closely into the bins, holding their cup over the opening.
